rows.title: Rows to show
rows.description: Each row counts this stream across every platform.

showRecords.title: Show the best stream on record
showRecords.description: A row lights up when this stream beats it.

hideZeroRows.title: Hide rows that are still at 0

tipsCurrency.title: Only count tips in this currency (optional)
tipsCurrency.description: Three letters, for example USD. Leave blank to count every tip as whole units.

resetCommand.title: Moderator reset command
resetCommand.description: Moderators type this (for example !scorereset) to start the counts again. Leave blank to turn it off.
